Boundaries:
- Product Brief v7 remains the current narrative baseline until v8 approval is recorded.
- CityChat DS Add-on v0.7 is approved normative authoring guidance; Product Experience Profile v0.4 remains a draft dependency.
- The v0.7.0 control, icon, motion and colour records bind this team-learning artifact only; gallery specimens do not enable product capabilities.
- CityScan interaction/spec material is proposed and runtime-unverified.
- LINE, persistence, receipts, sharing, officer operations, and telemetry are not enabled in this artifact.
- Open sources and verify important claims before promoting anything into a governed product object.
